facts.label: Front-garden hard surface area above which permitted development requires porous materials or drainage to a permeable area
facts.quote: F.2 Development is permitted by Class F subject to the condition that where— (a) the hard surface would be situated on land between a wall forming the principal elevation of the dwellinghouse and a highway, and (b) the area of ground covered by the hard surface, or the area of hard surface replaced, would exceed 5 square metres, either the hard surface is made of porous materials, or provision is made to direct run-off water from the hard surface to a permeable or porous area or surface within the curtilage of the dwellinghouse.
facts.scope: England. The Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) (England) Order 2015, Schedule 2, Part 1, Class F, condition F.2; applies to hard surfaces between the front (principal) elevation and a highway. Stated in the lowriskquotes patio and driveway cost guides.

facts.label: Maximum share of the curtilage that buildings other than the original house may cover after a permitted-development extension
facts.quote: (b) as a result of the works, the total area of ground covered by buildings within the curtilage of the dwellinghouse (other than the original dwellinghouse) would exceed 50% of the total area of the curtilage (excluding the ground area of the original dwellinghouse);
facts.scope: England. The Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) (England) Order 2015, Schedule 2, Part 1, Class A, paragraph A.1(b): development is not permitted by Class A if it would take coverage above this share. Stated in the lowriskquotes conservatory cost guide as 'do not cover more than half the garden'.

facts.label: Maximum floor area of a ground-level conservatory or porch extension exempt from the Building Regulations
facts.quote: CLASS 7 Extensions The extension of a building by the addition at ground level of— (a) a conservatory, porch, covered yard or covered way; or (b) a carport open on at least two sides; where the floor area of that extension does not exceed 30m2, provided that in the case of a conservatory or porch which is wholly or partly glazed, the glazing satisfies the requirements of … Part K4, K5.1, K5.2, K5.3, and K5.4 … Part N of Schedule 1.
facts.scope: England. The Building Regulations 2010, Schedule 2 (exempt buildings and work), Class 7; the glazing must still satisfy the Schedule 1 requirements the quote names. Stated in the lowriskquotes conservatory cost guide.

facts.label: Who may be employed to do gas work in domestic premises
facts.value: Anyone employed to work on gas appliances in domestic premises must be a Gas Safe registered engineer
facts.quote: Anyone employed to work on gas appliances in domestic premises must be a Gas Safe registered engineer and competent in that area of gas work.
facts.scope: Great Britain (the Gas Safety (Installation and Use) Regulations 1998, regulation 3; Northern Ireland has its own regulations). Stated in the lowriskquotes new-boiler cost guide.
